channel.title: Alabama News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: River Region women gather monthly to build leadership through faith
item.description: The Fellowship for Professional Women meets every second Tuesday at Wynlakes Golf & Country Club.

item.title: First United Methodist Hosts Senior Caregiver Resource Fair Thursday
item.description: The Senior Caregiver and Resource Fair will be held Thursday, Feb. 26, at First United Methodist Church, offering local families tools and guidance to better support the seniors in their lives.

item.title: Trojans punch their ticket to Birmingham with a win over Midfield
item.description: The Saint James Trojans are headed back to Birmingham to avenge their loss in the State Title Game a year ago. The Trojans take down Midfield to claim the Girls 3A Central Regional Crown.

item.title: Eagles head to Birmingham to defend their title
item.description: Montgomery Academy defeated Midfield in the 3A Boys Central Regional Championship Game to punch their ticket to Birmingham to defend their state title.

item.title: Southside-Selma defeats Bayside Academy for Regional Crown
item.description: The Southside Selma Panthers defeated Bayside Academy for the 3A Boys South Regional Championship.

item.title: Lady Trojans capture Regional Crown
item.description: The Charles Henderson Girls' Basketball Team captured the 5A Girls South Regional Title over St. Paul's.

item.title: Charles Henderson falls in Regional Finals
item.description: The Trojans come up short in the 5A Boys South Regional Championship Game against LeFlore.

item.title: Pleasant Grove and Montgomery Catholic meet in the 4A Girls Central Regional Final
item.description: The Knights take down the Spartans to keep their season alive.

item.title: Sylacauga and Marbury compete for the 5A Boys Central Regional Final
item.description: The Bulldogs and the Aggies combine for over 100 points in an offensive shootout.

item.title: Montgomery Catholic takes on Fairfield in the Central Regional Final
item.description: The Knights and the Tigers battle in out on the hardwood for Regional championship.
